prayerExcerpt.en-US: Walking faithfully in our vocation, we may constantly be examples of shining light.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Vivendo fielmente a nossa vocação, a vossa luz resplandeça em nossas obras.

meta.face: A MATRONLY woman of about sixty, a widow and foundress, with a BROAD, SQUARE face, full in the jaw — a long, straight, strong nose, wide-set clear grey-blue eyes with slightly heavy lids under straight, level brows, broad, flat cheekbones, a wide mouth with thin, closed lips and a faint, knowing smile, and a firm, squared chin; fair skin with visible fine lines at the eyes and mouth, hair hidden by the veil; a steady, direct, authoritative and kindly gaze straight at the viewer (NOT upturned, not girlish or delicate).
meta.basis: The seventeenth-century portrait type of the Visitation (the Wikipedia lead image): a broad oval face in the white guimpe, grey-blue eyes, long straight nose, thin smiling lips and the silver profession cross. The IHS heart recalls her carving the name of Jesus over her heart.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Jane Frances de Chantal (lead portrait, consulted)
Catholic Encyclopedia (1910), St. Jane Frances de Chantal
